rule: smallest mean shortlist with miss rate within 0.05 pp of the best no-fallback setting
decision: Keep the production config (60 m + 100/150 m fallbacks, top-K 15). Top-K, not radius, drives the miss rate on labelled points; radius >= 30 m looks sufficient only because confident labels are by definition <= 30 m from the route, so the sweep cannot penalise a small radius. At inference the pipeline also sees unlabelled points far from the route (GPS-to-route p90 ~48 m in results/eda), which a 30 m radius without fallback would leave candidate-free. K=15 is the knee of the miss-rate vs shortlist-size trade-off.
